title: Ambient and Interior Lighting
summary: Feedback centers on G70 ambient and interior lighting, with many customers praising its appearance and available lighting schemes while a substantial set of fragments only mention lighting without a clear evaluative stance.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the ambient lighting’s appearance, nighttime effect, interior coverage, and selectable schemes.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize specific lighting elements or styling, including a visor light issue and a newer ambient lighting look described as overly flashy.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention lighting features, settings, or requests such as color behavior and brightness controls without enough context to confirm clear satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: The sampled undetermined fragments are often too brief or incomplete to establish clear sentiment.
Examples are drawn from a stratified sample and are not representative estimates of all G70 feedback on this topic.
Some undetermined fragments describe questions or feature requests, which limits confidence in interpreting them as praise or complaints.
